scripts.build: if [ -d "frontend" ]; then (cd frontend && npm install && npm run build); else (npm install && npm run build); fi
scripts.dev: sh -c 'cd backend && python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 & BACK_PID=$!; trap "kill $BACK_PID 2>/dev/null" EXIT INT TERM; cd frontend && npm run dev'
